scope: Copied canonical, scientific and legacy JSON graph/pack/registry SDK interfaces compiled and executed outside the checkout with empty PATH, including asynchronous file loading, version-specific duplicates, UTF-16, UTF-8 replacement, missing-file refusals, live registry identities, frozen executable copies, query arrays and dependency drift. All 77 negative type controls receive independent compiler diagnostics. Eighteen workspace/adapter declarations receive bidirectional comparisons with explicit public registry substitutions. An installed custom registry and pure workspace assembly preserve source object identities. Sixteen correspondence/configuration/reference declarations receive bidirectional comparisons; three installed complete correspondence outputs plus shared-provenance/array identities, Set/own-field order, URI encoding/refusal and identifier/path checks use native operations. Nine diff/report declarations receive bidirectional comparisons; installed diff ordinal, documentation UTF-16, grouping and fresh empty-result controls use frozen expectations. Unchecked digest controls include locale order, integer-key enumeration, UTF-16 keys, invalid executable shapes and null TypeError dispatch. Three composition function/options/error declarations also receive bidirectional comparisons and installed merge/conflict/cross-shard checks. Eleven mapped pack/context and eighteen graph declarations plus the public registry/graph methods receive bidirectional type comparisons against declarations generated from unchanged original source. This closes no full-package or obligation-level parity gate. Reference types are comparison inputs only; no MetaMap runtime package is present in the copied consumer.
